The text provides several strong indicators of its historical setting. The presence of horse-drawn carriages and gas lighting suggests a pre-automotive, pre-electric era, typically associated with the 19th century. The architectural styles mentioned, Georgian and Victorian, further narrow this down; while Georgian architecture spans the 18th and early 19th centuries, the Victorian era specifically covers the reign of Queen Victoria from 1837 to 1901. The reference to Charles Dickens, whose major works were published between the 1830s and 1870s, aligns perfectly with the mid-to-late Victorian period. Therefore, the document likely dates to the mid-to-late 19th century, specifically within the Victorian era.
